title: CVT Controller
text: Continuously variable transmission controller, 4 outputs; {Maximum variator primary pulley radius, rp_max} sets the radius .08, {Maximum variator secondary pulley radius, rs_max} sets the radius .07, {Minimum variator primary pulley radius, rp_min} sets the radius .03, {Minimum variator secondary pulley radius, rs_min} sets the radius .03, {Gap distance between variator pulleys, rgap} sets the crown wheel and {Variator wedge angle, thetawedge} sets the crown wheel connection. Values come from the instance.
